rdfs:label: rrule
rdfs:comment: An iCalendar recurrence rule — declares the pattern by which a Vevent or Vtodo repeats (daily, weekly, every other Tuesday, …).
notes: Encodes RFC 5545's RRULE syntax — `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;UNTIL=20261231T000000Z`. The base event carries `dtstart` plus `rrule`; each instance is computed at read time, not stored. Recurrence is the single most-bug-prone area of calendar interop — many libraries diverge on edge cases (DST transitions, BYDAY in monthly rules, COUNT vs UNTIL). The W3C RDF Calendar vocabulary models RRULE as a structured node (`ical:freq`, `ical:interval`, `ical:byday`, `ical:until`, `ical:count`). Solid apps in this registry use the RFC 5545 string form as the value; consumers should accept both.
